description: Machine memory guard (ENG-0138): deny heavy local suites and commands that bypass tools/agent-guard/run-guarded.mjs. Requires one-time trust via /hooks.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking the command against the machine memory budget

hooks.command: H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event pre-tool-use # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event pre-command # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event pre-file-write # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event session-start # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event session-end # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event prompt-submit # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event post-tool-use # agent-bot agent-hook
H="${AGENT_BOT_HOOK_BIN:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-bot/agent-hook}"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; exec "$H" --dialect codex --event agent-stop # agent-bot agent-hook
